_comment: Daily send cap by UTC date. RE-WARM RAMP after the Sep 1-17 blackout: the mailbox sent nothing for 17 days, so resuming at the old 30/day would look like account compromise to Gmail's velocity filters. Ramp from cold. Dates past the ramp fall through to 'default' -- keep this file current or preflight's cold-start guard will clamp it anyway.
